personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with 1 iOS-Native Clean utility
personality_one_liner: A premium, magazine-like interface that elevates factory-direct interior operations into a high-end customer and staff experience.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial vertical spacing. Use md/lg for utility screens, xl/2xl for customer screens.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrollable lists (CRM/Customer Portal)
Use for the floating AI assistant chat button
dont's: Do not use on factory scanner screen to ensure maximum performance
Do not use on form inputs or dense data cards

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A premium gateway supporting both Staff (Email/Password) and Customer (Phone/OTP) authentication.

states.loading: Subtle loading spinner inside the primary black button.
states.error: Inline red text below the input fields or a top banner.

screens.layout: Minimalist single-column layout. Large elegant wordmark 'Interiojunction' in Playfair Display. Clean input fields with bottom borders or light #F0F0F0 background. A toggle for 'Customer' vs 'Staff' login. Primary button sticky above keyboard.

screens.name: Customer Portal (Home)
screens.purpose: Provides customers with a luxurious view of their project's progress and access to the AI design assistant.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for project cards and timeline.
states.empty: Elegant illustration of a drafted floor plan + 'No active projects yet. Start chatting with our AI to get a quote!'

screens.layout: Hero section featuring a real image of the project design (kitchen/wardrobe) with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Below, a horizontal or vertical step-by-step timeline (NEW → CUT → EDGE... → INSTALL). Floating Action Button (glass) for AI Design Assistant chat. Section for service tickets at the bottom.

screens.name: Factory Scanner
screens.purpose: A high-efficiency utility for factory staff to scan QR labels and advance parts through production.

states.empty: Camera view dominates, 'No recent scans' list below.
states.error: Large red toast/alert for invalid QR code with haptic error.

screens.layout: Top half is a full-width camera preview with a scanning frame overlay. Large touch targets. Bottom half is a bottom sheet or list showing 'Recent Scans' with part details and updated status chips. High contrast, scan-first workflow.

screens.name: Staff CRM Dashboard
screens.purpose: Admin and sales dashboard tracking leads, active projects, and open tickets.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No active projects or tickets.'

screens.layout: Editorial-style large headers. Horizontal scrollable summary cards (Projects, Tickets, Leads). Vertical list of active projects with #EAE4DB tinted status chips. Clean dividers (#F0F0F0) between list rows. Sticky filter row with glass effect.

customer_hero_kitchen.alt: Modern minimalist kitchen interior with grey cabinets

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app seamlessly handles role-based authentication and navigation routing. The UI must adapt completely based on the user's role (Customer vs Factory vs Staff).
Strictly follow the color palette. Use #FDFAF6 as the main background for the Customer Portal and CRM to match the interiojunction.in website. Use pure black (#000000) for primary buttons and text.
Implement the Factory Scanner screen with performance in mind. Maximize the camera viewport and use large, high-contrast touch targets. Do not use glassmorphism on the scanner screen.

For all hero images (like customer_hero_kitchen), apply the MANDATORY gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent at 0% -> 70% surfaceInverse at 100%) so that white text placed over the image remains readable.
Use Playfair Display for large display headings to give the app a premium, editorial interior-design feel. Use DM Sans for all body text, UI labels, and data fields.
Ensure the production stage timeline (NEW → CUT → EDGE → MACH → FQC → PACK → DISP → SITE/INSTALL) is clearly visualized using horizontal or vertical tracking steps in the Customer Portal.
